ROS Pocket — upstream

Independent upstream F-Droid repository for ROS Pocket. Not the official f-droid.org catalogue. Direct DDS ROS 2 inspector, read-only. APKs signed by the ROS Pocket upstream production key.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://lamggm.github.io/ros2_pocket/fdroid/repo

If you would like to manually verify the fingerprint (SHA-256) of the repository signing key, here it is:
